akr_prior.text: The cats of St Nicholas keep the snakes down, and the snakes keep the cats interested. Welcome, and please don't feed them. They have a rota.
We have a legend, a bell, a garden and about thirty cats. The cats are the only ones with a clear idea of how the day should go.

akr_cat.text: It looks at you for a long moment, decides it has better things to do, and goes to sit on a prayer book.
